_doc.zh: 面部表情肌的参数化定义。几何（作用线两端、宽度）在构建时从肌肉部件的网格量出；这里给的是量不出来的东西：哪一端是固定端（hint：从活动端指向固定端的大致方向，按身体左侧书写，x 为外侧、y 为上、z 为前，右侧取镜像）、作用区域的限制（mask）、以及全激活时皮肤的最大位移（excursionMm）。attachments 的文字依据 soma 知识层里各肌的起止点条目（出处见 sources.json 的 soma-knowledge）。excursionMm、spreadMm、reachMm、sectors 都是本项目的假设，没有出处。模型里没有的肌肉列在 missing。
_doc.en: Parametric definitions of the muscles of facial expression. Geometry (both ends of the line of action, width) is measured from the muscle part meshes at build time; this file supplies what cannot be measured: which end is the fixed one (`hint`: the rough direction from the mobile end to the fixed end, written for the body's left side with x lateral, y up, z anterior; mirrored for the right), limits of the zone of influence (`mask`), and the largest skin displacement at full activation (`excursionMm`). The `attachments` text follows the origin and insertion entries of each muscle in the soma knowledge layer (see soma-knowledge in sources.json). `excursionMm`, `spreadMm`, `reachMm` and `sectors` are assumptions of this project and have no source. Muscles the model lacks are listed under `missing`.

model.zh: linear：把活动端附近的皮肤拉向固定端；sphincter：把环周围的皮肤拉向环心；lid：眼睑沿眼球表面开合。
model.en: linear: pulls the skin round the mobile end towards the fixed end; sphincter: draws the skin round the ring towards its centre; lid: an eyelid sliding over the globe.

spreadMm.zh: 作用区在肌肉半宽之外向两侧延伸的距离
spreadMm.en: how far the zone of influence extends sideways beyond the muscle's half-width

reachMm.zh: 作用区越过活动端继续延伸的距离
reachMm.en: how far the zone of influence extends beyond the mobile end

mask.zh: aboveStomion / belowStomion：只作用于口裂以上 / 以下（上唇肌不动下唇）；aboveEye / belowEye：只作用于睑裂以上 / 以下。
mask.en: aboveStomion / belowStomion: acts only above / below the oral fissure (upper-lip muscles leave the lower lip alone); aboveEye / belowEye: acts only above / below the palpebral fissure.

carryMm.zh: 越过活动端后权重保持为 1 的距离（肌肉止于其中的组织被整体带动），之后才在 reachMm 内衰减
carryMm.en: distance beyond the mobile end over which the weight stays 1 (the tissue the muscle inserts into is carried as a whole), before it decays over reachMm

insertAt.zh: modiolus：皮肤上的活动端不取肌肉网格末端在皮肤上的最近点，而取皮肤上的口角轴（口角外侧 3 mm，从正前方投影到皮肤）。原因：皮肤比这些肌肉浅 12–18 mm，最近点会落到口角外侧 15–20 mm 的颊部。
insertAt.en: modiolus: the mobile end on the skin is not the skin point nearest to the end of the muscle mesh but the modiolus on the skin (3 mm lateral to the corner of the mouth, projected onto the skin from straight ahead). Reason: the skin lies 12–18 mm superficial to these muscles, and the nearest point would fall on the cheek 15–20 mm lateral to the corner of the mouth.

hangMm.zh: 作用线下方的皮肤被多带动的距离：眉下到上睑的皮肤是挂在眉上的，眉被拉动时它整片跟着走，到睑缘上方被 mask 截住。数值是假设。
hangMm.en: how much further the skin below the line is carried: the skin from under the brow to the upper lid hangs from the brow and moves with it as a whole, until the mask stops it above the lid margin. The value is an assumption.

project.zh: front：作用线两端从正前方投影到皮肤，而不是取皮肤上的最近点。颏部软组织厚，最近点会偏到外侧约 20 mm，使颏肌的拉力变成横向。
project.en: front: both ends of the line are projected onto the skin from straight ahead instead of taking the nearest skin point. The chin's soft tissue is thick and the nearest point falls about 20 mm laterally, which turned the pull of mentalis sideways.

axis.zh: hint：作用线方向直接取 hint，不用网格的主轴。颏肌的网格约 14 × 14 × 7 mm，近似一个团块，主轴斜向外上，量出来的作用线把颏部皮肤拉向外侧而不是向上。
axis.en: hint: the line of action takes the hint direction outright instead of the mesh's principal axis. The mentalis mesh is about 14 × 14 × 7 mm, nearly a blob, whose principal axis runs obliquely up and out, so the measured line pulled the chin skin sideways rather than up.

split.zh: 把场按到正中的距离分成内侧、外侧两个通道（额肌：内侧部 → AU1，外侧部 → AU2）。atMm 是分界到正中的距离，blendMm 是过渡带的半宽；两个数是假设（约在眉的中点）。
split.en: splits the field by distance from the midline into a medial and a lateral channel (frontalis: pars medialis → AU1, pars lateralis → AU2). atMm is the distance of the boundary from the midline and blendMm the half-width of the blend; both are assumptions (about the middle of the brow).

lip.zh: 沿唇的延续（只用于有真实口裂的皮肤）。corner：止于口角轴的肌肉把整条唇带着走，份额从口角的 1 平滑降到正中的 0，所以口角被拉动时唇跟着伸长而不是在口角内侧断开。middle：唇的提肌 / 降肌的场沿唇缘延伸到正中，到口角降为 0。bandMm 是离口裂多远处降为 0。轮廓和数值都是假设。
lip.en: Carry along the lip (opened skin only). corner: a muscle inserting at the modiolus carries the whole lip, its share falling smoothly from 1 at the corner to 0 at the midline, so that a pulled corner stretches the lip instead of breaking off just medial to the corner. middle: the field of a lip elevator / depressor runs along the margin to the midline and falls to 0 at the corner. bandMm is the distance from the fissure at which it reaches 0. Profiles and numbers are assumptions.

note.zh: 闭合线取在下睑缘之上、睑裂高度的 closureFraction 处：闭眼主要靠上睑下落，下睑只上抬一点。皮肤有真实睑裂时，睑缘到眼球（巩膜、角膜）表面至少留 gapMm；闭合的皮肤和深层的眼睑各越过闭合线 overlapMm（开口的皮肤上最多 0.25 mm）。这些数都是假设。
note.en: The lids meet at `closureFraction` of the aperture above the lower lid margin: closing is mostly the upper lid coming down, the lower lid rising a little. With a real fissure in the skin the margin keeps at least gapMm from the globe surface (sclera, cornea); on a closed skin and for the deep lids each lid travels overlapMm past the closure line (at most 0.25 mm on an opened skin). All these numbers are assumptions.

followersNote.zh: 皮肤之外，只有名字匹配 followers 的部件随眼睑通道移动；否则贴在眼球上的眼外肌止点也会被带着走。
followersNote.en: Apart from the skin, only parts whose name matches `followers` move with the lid channels; otherwise the insertions of the extraocular muscles on the globe would be dragged along.

note.zh: 咀嚼肌不产生皮肤位移场：它们通过骨架绑定里的颞下颌关节（tmj）起作用。张口还靠二腹肌等舌骨上肌，这里没有列为通道。
note.en: The masticatory muscles produce no skin displacement field: they act through the temporomandibular joint (tmj) of the rig. Opening also uses the digastric and other suprahyoid muscles, which are not channels here.

note.zh: 两个体型的数据里都没有这块肌肉（AU4 的肌肉基础之一）；AU4 只由皱眉肌和降眉间肌驱动。
note.en: Neither body has this muscle (part of the muscular basis of AU4); AU4 is driven by corrugator supercilii and procerus only.

note.zh: 数据里没有；上睑的开合只用一个眼睑通道表示。
note.en: Not in the data; the upper lid is represented by one lid channel.

insertion.zh: 眉部和额部皮肤，与眼轮匝肌交织
insertion.en: skin of the eyebrow and forehead, blending with orbicularis oculi

action.zh: 上提眉毛，额部出现横纹
action.en: raises the eyebrow; horizontal forehead furrows

origin.en: medial end of the superciliary arch

insertion.zh: 眉中部上方的额部皮肤
insertion.en: skin of the forehead above the middle of the eyebrow

action.zh: 把眉毛拉向内下方，眉间出现纵纹
action.en: draws the eyebrow medially and down; vertical glabellar furrows

origin.zh: 鼻骨和鼻外侧软骨上部的筋膜
origin.en: fascia over the nasal bone and the upper lateral nasal cartilage

action.zh: 把眉内侧端的皮肤向下拉，鼻根出现横纹
action.en: pulls the skin between the brows down; transverse furrow at the root of the nose

insertion.en: alar cartilage and skin of the nose, upper lip

action.zh: 上提鼻翼和上唇，鼻背两侧起皱
action.en: lifts the ala of the nose and the upper lip; wrinkles along the sides of the nose

carryNote.zh: 肌肉网格的下端止于鼻唇沟一带，没有伸进上唇；真实的肌纤维止于上唇（和鼻翼）的皮肤。carryMm 让权重在越过网格末端后先保持为 1，直到被口裂的 mask 截断，这样被上提的是上唇本身。数值是假设。
carryNote.en: The muscle mesh ends near the nasolabial furrow and does not reach into the upper lip, whereas the real fibres insert into the skin of the upper lip (and ala). carryMm keeps the weight at 1 beyond the end of the mesh until the oral-fissure mask cuts it off, so that it is the upper lip itself that is raised. The value is an assumption.

insertion.en: skin and muscle of the upper lip

action.zh: 上提上唇，加深鼻唇沟
action.en: raises the upper lip; deepens the nasolabial furrow

carryNote.zh: 肌肉网格的下端止于鼻唇沟一带，没有伸进上唇；真实的肌纤维止于上唇（和鼻翼）的皮肤。carryMm 让权重在越过网格末端后先保持为 1，直到被口裂的 mask 截断，这样被上提的是上唇本身。数值是假设。
carryNote.en: The muscle mesh ends near the nasolabial furrow and does not reach into the upper lip, whereas the real fibres insert into the skin of the upper lip (and ala). carryMm keeps the weight at 1 beyond the end of the mesh until the oral-fissure mask cuts it off, so that it is the upper lip itself that is raised. The value is an assumption.

action.zh: 把上唇向外上方拉
action.en: draws the upper lip up and laterally

carryNote.zh: 肌肉网格的下端止于鼻唇沟一带，没有伸进上唇；真实的肌纤维止于上唇（和鼻翼）的皮肤。carryMm 让权重在越过网格末端后先保持为 1，直到被口裂的 mask 截断，这样被上提的是上唇本身。数值是假设。
carryNote.en: The muscle mesh ends near the nasolabial furrow and does not reach into the upper lip, whereas the real fibres insert into the skin of the upper lip (and ala). carryMm keeps the weight at 1 beyond the end of the mesh until the oral-fissure mask cuts it off, so that it is the upper lip itself that is raised. The value is an assumption.

origin.en: anterior surface of the zygomatic bone

insertion.en: modiolus at the angle of the mouth

action.zh: 把口角向外上方拉
action.en: pulls the angle of the mouth up and laterally

action.zh: 上提口角
action.en: raises the angle of the mouth

action.zh: 把口角向外侧水平拉开
action.en: stretches the angle of the mouth straight to the side

origin.zh: 上下颌骨牙槽突、翼突下颌缝
origin.en: alveolar processes of maxilla and mandible, pterygomandibular raphe

insertion.zh: 口角轴，与口轮匝肌交织

action.zh: 把颊压向牙列，口角向后收紧
action.en: presses the cheek against the teeth; tightens the angle of the mouth backwards

action.zh: 把口角向下拉
action.en: pulls the angle of the mouth down

origin.zh: 下颌骨斜线（颏联合与颏孔之间）
origin.en: oblique line of the mandible, between the symphysis and the mental foramen

insertion.en: skin of the lower lip, orbicularis oris fibres

action.zh: 把下唇向下、略向外拉
action.en: draws the lower lip down and a little laterally

action.zh: 上提颏部皮肤，使下唇前突
action.en: raises the skin of the chin and pushes the lower lip up and forward

origin.zh: 上颌骨（切牙和尖牙上方）
origin.en: maxilla, above the incisor and canine teeth

insertion.en: aponeurosis over the bridge of the nose, alar cartilage

action.zh: 压窄或开大鼻孔
action.en: compresses or flares the nostril

origin.zh: 锁骨上下区的皮下组织
origin.en: subcutaneous tissue of the infraclavicular and supraclavicular regions

insertion.zh: 下颌底、颊部和下唇的皮肤、口角、口轮匝肌
insertion.en: base of the mandible, skin of cheek and lower lip, angle of the mouth, orbicularis oris

action.zh: 把下唇和口角向下外方拉，绷紧颈部皮肤
action.en: draws the lower lip and the angle of the mouth down and laterally; tenses the skin of the neck

origin.zh: 睑内侧韧带、上颌骨额突、额骨鼻部
origin.en: medial palpebral ligament, frontal process of the maxilla, nasal part of the frontal bone

insertion.zh: 环绕眶缘回到起点；纤维附着于眉和颊部皮肤
insertion.en: sweeps round the orbital margin back to its origin; fibres attach to the skin of the brow and cheek

action.zh: 环形收缩：上提颊部、压低眉外侧、挤窄睑裂，眼外侧出现鱼尾纹
action.en: contracts as a ring: raises the cheek, lowers the lateral brow, narrows the eye opening; crow's feet at the outer corner

action.zh: 上睑下落闭眼（同时上睑提肌放松）
action.en: lowers the upper lid to close the eye (levator palpebrae superioris relaxes at the same time)

action.zh: 下睑上抬并绷紧
action.en: raises and tightens the lower lid

action.zh: 闭唇、缩唇
action.en: closes and purses the lips

name.zh: 口裂内陷（闭合皮肤上的几何替代）
name.en: oral recess (geometric stand-in on a closed skin)

action.zh: 皮肤是一张闭合的面，唇不能分开。张口时把两唇相贴的那道褶向口内推 excursionMm，褶上下 spreadMm 内渐变，让下颌张开时被拉开的皮肤成为一个凹陷，而不是一张平的膜。两个数都是假设。
action.en: The skin is one closed surface and the lips cannot part. On mouth opening the crease where the lips meet is pushed excursionMm into the mouth, fading over spreadMm above and below it, so that the skin stretched by the opening jaw forms a hollow rather than a flat membrane. Both numbers are assumptions.

name.zh: 口角成形（开口皮肤上的几何修正）
name.en: mouth-corner shaping (geometric correction on an opened skin)

action.zh: 皮肤有真实口裂时，骨架把上唇缘绑在颅骨、下唇缘绑在下颌，一直到口角，单靠关节张口时口裂两端是竖直的（方口）。这个通道在离口角 excursionMm 以内让唇缘跟随下颌的份额逐渐过渡到口角处的 0.5，使口裂呈杏仁形。它的激活应等于下颌张开角 / 上限。excursionMm（过渡长度）是假设。
action.en: With a real oral fissure the rig binds the upper lip margin to the skull and the lower to the jaw right up to the corners, so opened by the joint alone the fissure has vertical ends (a square mouth). Within excursionMm of a corner this channel eases the jaw share of the lip margins to 0.5 at the corner, giving an almond-shaped aperture. Its activation should equal jaw opening / limit. excursionMm (the taper length) is an assumption.

origin.zh: 蝶骨小翼（视神经管上方）
origin.en: lesser wing of the sphenoid, above the optic canal

insertion.en: superior tarsal plate and skin of the upper eyelid

action.zh: 上提上睑。肌肉在眶内、皮肤之下很深，不能像其他表情肌那样按作用线在皮肤上投影；这里实现为上睑缘沿眼球表面上移 raiseMm（中间最多，两眦为 0），睑的皮肤跟随，只在有真实睑裂的皮肤上有。raiseMm 是假设。
action.en: Raises the upper lid. The muscle lies inside the orbit, far below the skin, and cannot be projected onto the skin as a line of action like the other muscles; it is implemented as the upper lid margin rising along the globe by raiseMm (most in the middle, nothing at the canthi) with the lid skin following, only on a skin with a real fissure. raiseMm is an assumption.

name.zh: 下唇上抬闭合（双唇闭合）
name.en: lower lip raised to seal (bilabial closure)

action.zh: 下唇缘走到上唇缘上，与下颌是否张开无关：在下颌张开 refJawFraction 的姿势下求解，正好抵消下颌带给下唇的位移。运行时激活 = 闭合量 × 下颌角 / refJaw（不超过 1）。肌肉基础：口轮匝肌、颏肌。 几何通道：直接规定唇缘怎样走，不是按肌肉力学算的；幅度和轮廓是假设。只在有真实口裂的皮肤上有。
action.en: The lower lip margin travels onto the upper whatever the jaw does: solved in the pose with the jaw opened by refJawFraction, it exactly undoes what the jaw does to the lower lip. Run-time activation = closure × jaw angle / refJaw (at most 1). Muscular basis: orbicularis oris, mentalis. A geometric channel: it prescribes how the lip margin travels and is not computed from muscle mechanics; excursion and profile are assumptions. Present only on a skin with a real oral fissure.

name.zh: 下唇贴上切牙切缘（唇齿音）
name.en: lower lip to the upper incisal edge (labiodental)

action.zh: 下唇缘中段（正中两侧各 spreadMm，再经 reachMm 渐隐）走到上切牙切缘的前下方，在下颌张开 refJawFraction 的姿势下求解。 几何通道：直接规定唇缘怎样走，不是按肌肉力学算的；幅度和轮廓是假设。只在有真实口裂的皮肤上有。
action.en: The middle of the lower lip margin (spreadMm either side of the midline, fading over reachMm) travels to just below and in front of the incisal edge of the upper incisors, solved in the pose with the jaw opened by refJawFraction. A geometric channel: it prescribes how the lip margin travels and is not computed from muscle mechanics; excursion and profile are assumptions. Present only on a skin with a real oral fissure.

action.zh: 两唇沿口的朝向前移，正中最多，口角处为五分之一；与口轮匝肌的缩窄一起构成圆唇。 几何通道：直接规定唇缘怎样走，不是按肌肉力学算的；幅度和轮廓是假设。只在有真实口裂的皮肤上有。
action.en: Both lips move forward along the facing of the mouth, most at the midline and a fifth of that at the corners; with the narrowing of orbicularis oris this makes lip rounding. A geometric channel: it prescribes how the lip margin travels and is not computed from muscle mechanics; excursion and profile are assumptions. Present only on a skin with a real oral fissure.

action.zh: 上唇缘向口内退，红唇变窄（AU23 收紧、AU28 吸唇）。 几何通道：直接规定唇缘怎样走，不是按肌肉力学算的；幅度和轮廓是假设。只在有真实口裂的皮肤上有。
action.en: The upper lip margin retreats into the mouth and the vermilion narrows (AU23 tightening, AU28 lip suck). A geometric channel: it prescribes how the lip margin travels and is not computed from muscle mechanics; excursion and profile are assumptions. Present only on a skin with a real oral fissure.

action.zh: 下唇缘向口内退，红唇变窄。 几何通道：直接规定唇缘怎样走，不是按肌肉力学算的；幅度和轮廓是假设。只在有真实口裂的皮肤上有。
action.en: The lower lip margin retreats into the mouth and the vermilion narrows. A geometric channel: it prescribes how the lip margin travels and is not computed from muscle mechanics; excursion and profile are assumptions. Present only on a skin with a real oral fissure.

action.zh: 两唇互相压紧：红唇上下压扁（离口裂 h 处的顶点向口裂走 0.5 h，唇缘不动），并整体向后贴 excursionMm（AU24）。 几何通道：直接规定唇缘怎样走，不是按肌肉力学算的；幅度和轮廓是假设。只在有真实口裂的皮肤上有。
action.en: The lips are pressed together: the vermilion is flattened vertically (a vertex at height h from the fissure travels 0.5 h towards it; the margins stay) and the whole is pressed back by excursionMm (AU24). A geometric channel: it prescribes how the lip margin travels and is not computed from muscle mechanics; excursion and profile are assumptions. Present only on a skin with a real oral fissure.

action.zh: 上唇缘中段下移（下颌张开时上唇向下去够下唇）。下颌闭合时使用会穿进下唇。 几何通道：直接规定唇缘怎样走，不是按肌肉力学算的；幅度和轮廓是假设。只在有真实口裂的皮肤上有。
action.en: The middle of the upper lip margin moves down (the upper lip reaching for the lower with the jaw open). Used with the jaw closed it runs into the lower lip. A geometric channel: it prescribes how the lip margin travels and is not computed from muscle mechanics; excursion and profile are assumptions. Present only on a skin with a real oral fissure.

action.zh: 舌尖抬向牙槽嵴（t d n l s z）。 示意性的姿势：舌是一个约 200 个顶点的部件，这里只是按沿舌长的位置加权的位移，不是舌肌；幅度是假设。
action.en: The tip rises towards the alveolar ridge (t d n l s z). A schematic pose: the tongue is one part of about 200 vertices and this is only a displacement weighted by position along its length, not the tongue muscles; the excursion is an assumption.

action.zh: 舌前部抬向硬腭（i e、sh ch j）。 示意性的姿势：舌是一个约 200 个顶点的部件，这里只是按沿舌长的位置加权的位移，不是舌肌；幅度是假设。
action.en: The front rises towards the hard palate (i e; sh ch j). A schematic pose: the tongue is one part of about 200 vertices and this is only a displacement weighted by position along its length, not the tongue muscles; the excursion is an assumption.

action.zh: 舌后部抬向软腭（k g、u o）。 示意性的姿势：舌是一个约 200 个顶点的部件，这里只是按沿舌长的位置加权的位移，不是舌肌；幅度是假设。
action.en: The back rises towards the soft palate (k g; u o). A schematic pose: the tongue is one part of about 200 vertices and this is only a displacement weighted by position along its length, not the tongue muscles; the excursion is an assumption.

action.zh: 舌整体放低（a）。 示意性的姿势：舌是一个约 200 个顶点的部件，这里只是按沿舌长的位置加权的位移，不是舌肌；幅度是假设。
action.en: The whole tongue lowers (a). A schematic pose: the tongue is one part of about 200 vertices and this is only a displacement weighted by position along its length, not the tongue muscles; the excursion is an assumption.

note.zh: 皮肤滑动引起的厚度变化：w = −gain · H · div_s(u)，沿法线向外。gain = 0.5 来自不可压软组织层、线性剪切剖面的体积守恒，不是拟合出来的；H 是皮肤到骨的距离，限制在 minMm–maxMm；|w| 不超过 limitMm；散度在网格上平滑 smoothing 遍。minMm、maxMm、limitMm、smoothing 是假设。
note.en: Change of thickness caused by the sliding of the skin: w = −gain · H · div_s(u), along the outward normal. gain = 0.5 follows from volume conservation of an incompressible soft-tissue layer with a linear shear profile and is not fitted; H is the distance from skin to bone, limited to minMm–maxMm; |w| is capped at limitMm; the divergence is smoothed over the mesh `smoothing` times. minMm, maxMm, limitMm and smoothing are assumptions.

creaseNote.zh: creasePasses：褶皱（口裂、鼻旁、睑缘外）附近把每个通道的位移场在网格上抹匀的遍数，用来消除口角和鼻旁的锯齿。数值是假设。
creaseNote.en: creasePasses: how many times each channel's field is evened out over the mesh near creases (oral fissure, beside the nose, outside the lid margins), to remove the jagged shards at the mouth corners and beside the nose. The value is an assumption.

note.zh: 口角的交接和保面积处理（开口的皮肤）。上唇肌和下唇肌的场按绕口角的角度坐标做单位分解：上唇份额 = 0.5 + 0.5·S(θ)·ρ(r)，S 在 |θ| ≥ saturationDeg 处饱和，ρ 在离口角 handoverMm 内从 0 升到 1。每个通道算完后，口角 zoneMm 内的三角形若在全激活时翻折或面积比超出 [minAreaRatio, maxAreaRatio]，就把位移向邻居抹匀，最多 foldPasses 遍。全部数值是假设。
note.en: Hand-over and area-preserving treatment at the mouth corners (opened skin). The fields of upper-lip and lower-lip muscles are partitioned in an angular coordinate about the corner: upper share = 0.5 + 0.5·S(θ)·ρ(r), S saturating at |θ| ≥ saturationDeg and ρ rising from 0 to 1 within handoverMm of the corner. After each channel is evaluated, triangles within zoneMm of a corner that fold at full activation or whose area ratio leaves [minAreaRatio, maxAreaRatio] have their displacement evened towards their neighbours, for at most foldPasses passes. All numbers are assumptions.
